ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the power source is labeled 10sin(1000t) and is located at the bottom; there is a 4Ω resistor at the upper left of the circuit, a 1Ω resistor in the central vertical branch, and a 5Ω resistor in the middle on the right. On the left there is a parallel LC box, with the capacitor labeled 250μF and the inductor labeled 4mH; on the upper right there is another parallel LC box, with the capacitor labeled 2μF and the inductor labeled 500mH. Reasoning: The peak voltage of the source 10sin(1000t) is 10 V, and the angular frequency is ω=1000 rad/s. For the left parallel LC branch, the admittance Y=jωC+1/(jωL)=j(ωC-1/(ωL)). Here ωC=1000×250×10^-6=0.25 and 1/(ωL)=1/(1000×4×10^-3)=0.25, so the total admittance is 0; this parallel LC has an equivalent impedance of infinity at this frequency and is equivalent to an open circuit. For the right parallel LC branch, ωC=1000×2×10^-6=0.002 and 1/(ωL)=1/(1000×500×10^-3)=0.002, so the total admittance is also 0, the equivalent impedance is infinity, and it is also equivalent to an open circuit. After removing these two open-circuit branches, the only closed path across the source terminals is the series connection of 4Ω, 1Ω, and 5Ω, with total resistance 4+1+5=10Ω. Therefore, the steady-state current peak value is I_peak=10/10=1 A. The 1Ω resistor is in the series path, so the peak current through it is also 1 A.

method.method_draft: Treat the 1 Ω resistor as the load and remove it. Use the image topology to identify the two shunt LC blocks attached to the load terminals. At the given frequency, compute that both LC blocks are parallel-resonant opens. With the load removed, the upper load terminal has no drop through the 4 Ω resistor and is at the left rail, while the lower terminal has no drop through the 5 Ω resistor and is at the right rail, so Vth has peak magnitude 10 V. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个交流电路，底部电压源标为 10sin(1000t)。左、右两侧是供电轨。上方左侧有一个 4Ω 电阻，从左轨接到 1Ω 竖直电阻的上端节点；下方右侧有一个 5Ω 电阻，从 1Ω 竖直电阻的下端节点接到右轨。1Ω 电阻竖直接在上下两个中间节点之间。左下方有一个并联 LC 支路，标为 250μF 电容与 4mH 电感，接在左轨和 1Ω 下端节点之间。右上方有另一个并联 LC 支路，标为 2μF 电容与 500mH 电感，接在 1Ω 上端节点和右轨之间。

推理：按指定方法，把 1Ω 电阻作为负载并先移除。电源角频率为 ω = 1000 rad/s。左下并联 LC 的 L = 4mH、C = 250μF，LC = 0.004 × 250×10^-6 = 10^-6，因此 1/sqrt(LC) = 1000 rad/s，在该频率并联谐振，等效为开路。右上并联 LC 的 L = 500mH、C = 2μF，LC = 0.5 × 2×10^-6 = 10^-6，也在 1000 rad/s 并联谐振，等效为开路。负载移除后，由于两个 LC 支路开路，4Ω 电阻中无电流，所以负载上端节点与左轨等电位；5Ω 电阻中无电流，所以负载下端节点与右轨等电位。因此开路戴维南电压峰值为电源峰值 10V。求戴维南阻抗时，将理想电压源短路，左右供电轨成为同一节点；两个谐振 LC 支路仍为开路，于是从负载两端看进去，上端经 4Ω 到公共节点，下端经 5Ω 到公共节点，等效电阻为 4Ω + 5Ω = 9Ω。重新接入 1Ω 负载，峰值电流为 I_peak = 10 / (9 + 1) = 1A。

Reasoning: The peak voltage of the source 10sin(1000t) is 10 V, and the angular frequency is ω=1000 rad/s. For the left parallel LC branch, the admittance Y=jωC+1/(jωL)=j(ωC-1/(ωL)). Here ωC=1000×250×10^-6=0.25 and 1/(ωL)=1/(1000×4×10^-3)=0.25, so the total admittance is 0; this parallel LC has an equivalent impedance of infinity at this frequency and is equivalent to an open circuit. For the right parallel LC branch, ωC=1000×2×10^-6=0.002 and 1/(ωL)=1/(1000×500×10^-3)=0.002, so the total admittance is also 0, the equivalent impedance is infinity, and it is also equivalent to an open circuit. After removing these two open-circuit branches, the only closed path across the source terminals is the series connection of 4Ω, 1Ω, and 5Ω, with total resistance 4+1+5=10Ω. Therefore, the steady-state current peak value is I_peak=10/10=1 A. The 1Ω resistor is in the series path, so the peak current through it is also 1 A.
